dialogues.speaker: Confused Inazuman Contestant
dialogues.text: It's so easy to get lost on this mountain. I almost missed the turning for the camp.

dialogues.speaker: Exasperated Inazuman Contestant
dialogues.text: You can't blame that on the mountain. Yes, it's not the easiest terrain to navigate, but you have no sense of direction. Heck, you can barely find the toilet in your own home!
